findings.text: non-blocking: `_section_run_unlanded` returns False when the project has no registered checkout, so a section declared done whose run delivered or was promoted releases its waiters with the landing never checked — a fail-open in the guard this node exists to add, where `_request_state` at reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:3512 treats the same condition as PENDING.

non-blocking: the added function re-derives the `(plan, section)` identity over live pointers and ledger rows and applies `_revision_is_ancestor` itself, duplicating the derivation in reckon/crew/runs.py:2348 `_unloaded_sections` without calling or extending it, so the two answers to "is this section's promotion reachable" can drift.

non-blocking: the done-when's `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` result on the staged paths is recorded neither in `tests:` nor in `test_logs:`, though both pass on the landed files (verified separately); the regression arms logs/regression-suite.log and logs/regression-base.log that back the fragment's "30 failed, 38 passed" claim are also absent from `test_logs:`.

non-blocking: the reproduction log names `test_a_delivered_unlanded_run_holds_the_wait_until_armed_into_head`, a test that does not exist in the landed file (it is `..._until_merged_into_head` at tests/test_a_wait_releases_when_its_upstream_lands.py:244), so a reader cannot map its failing ids to the landed tests.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against bc6d7fd9f1306f21d21daa58f44f235265e6cca3; 9d35ace1d4b6 adds the guard and the tests, 802b764ac67f adds the evidence fragment, and the code change is confined to the section-ref resolution paths in reckon/crew/queue_admission.py.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/test_a_wait_releases_when_its_upstream_lands.py, a base-revision reproduction log, four cases, and a negative control; the landed test file at tests/test_a_wait_releases_when_its_upstream_lands.py:244-310 covers the four cases in three functions, and logs/base-revision-reproduction.log and logs/negative-control.log record both red runs.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a section wait releases when its upstream lands, not when it is declared done; reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:3378 `_section_run_unlanded` is consulted at every section-ref resolution point and holds a waiter while a run of the section has delivered or been promoted off HEAD.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states status complete, 54 passed at the head against 51 at the base arm, a parsed baseline_suite and after_suite pair both with zero failures, and a negative control log, but it records no ruff result though the done-when requires one.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's four declared paths — reckon/crew/queue_admission.py, the new test, the evidence fragment and the figures directory; the diff touches the first three only and nothing outside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_wait_releases_when_its_upstream_lands.py:259 and :294 fail at the base revision, and the declared negative control at reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:3412 reddens the same two cases.
justifications.evidence: logs/after-suite.log records "54 passed" EXIT=0 at the head and logs/base-revision-reproduction.log records "2 failed, 1 passed" EXIT=1 at the base, but the done-when's ruff gate at manifest.md:12 is recorded nowhere.
justifications.fit: the new helpers follow the module's lazy-import and `#:`-comment idiom of reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:3352-3376, and carry no plan, section or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:3419-3456 holds a waiter for a run that delivered per its manifest or whose promoted revision is not an ancestor of HEAD, which is the §40 deliverable.
justifications.reuse: the guard reuses `_revision_is_ancestor` and `project_mount_repository` but re-derives the (plan, section) identity and ledger scan that reckon/crew/runs.py:2348 `_unloaded_sections` already owns.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the two commits is inside the declared write paths, with no figure written and no unrelated edit.
